As an integrated geophysicist with 20+ years of hands-on experience, my career is dedicated to shifting geoscience from traditional, siloed, and manual workflows to an integrated, AI-powered paradigm that accelerates subsurface discovery and de-risks exploration. At Saudi Aramco, I led high-impact projects where I pioneered advanced workflows and algorithms for fault/fracture detection, paleo-channel mapping, and complex subsurface feature identification. These innovations, grounded in rigorous 3D geological modeling and multi-attribute seismic analysis, delivered deeper insights into subsurface complexities, directly contributing to precise well placement and reduced drilling risks. Today, I drive transformative initiatives centered on Multi-Physics Data Integration powered by Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning. Using advanced Prompt Engineering and AI Agents, I seamlessly fuse diverse datasets (including seismic, gravity, magnetic, electromagnetic, radiometric, hyperspectral, and remote sensing) in real-time to create dynamic, predictive subsurface models. This approach eliminates interpretive bias, automates complex workflows, shortens discovery timelines, and empowers teams with confident, data-driven decisions. To push the boundaries further, I've developed a suite of custom, in-house AI tools that bridge cutting-edge technology with real-world geoscience challenges: Pixel-to-Mineral Prospectivity Mapper: Processes open-source Landsat-9 data to generate targeted heat maps for critical minerals, guiding efficient field prioritization. Hyperspectral Mineral Identifier: Precisely maps and classifies mineral signatures from hyperspectral imagery to local scales. Mineral Systems Integrator: Fuses geochemical, geophysical, and geological data (validated on synthetic datasets) for comprehensive mineral system modeling. Pre-Stack Seismic Inversion Engine: Bayesian MCMC-based inversion (Metropolis-Hastings) for high-resolution subsurface imaging. AVO Inversion Suite: Enhances hydrocarbon detection and reservoir characterization through advanced amplitude analysis. Post-Stack Seismic Inversion Platform: Delivers robust acoustic and elastic property estimation. These tools enable faster, more accurate, and cost-effective interpretation, proving that sovereign, customizable AI can revolutionize exploration outcomes. I'm passionate about collaborating with forward-thinking teams to deploy these solutions in real-world projects, whether in mineral exploration, hydrocarbon development, or geohazard assessment.

job_description: We are on our journey to create a product that is simple to use, intuitive enough for your mom, will not force you into boxes, and can allow for the simplest to the most complex of collaborations.
summary: Have you ever gone on a road trip? Or worked on a school project? Or planned a party with your friends? Or collaborated on projects with your colleagues at work? Or brainstormed on ideas with your fellow entrepreneurs? The one thing which is common in all of these activities is that you are interacting, collaborating, and trying to achieve an end goal. The goal can be small or big. The output can be simple or complex. But the journey remains the same. The tools which we use as a part of the journey tend to be a combination of a phone/video call, a text chat tool, an email, a to-do list tool, or a work collaboration and management tool. We end up using some combination of all of these to collaborate on the simplest of stuff. Either they are unstructured and allow for asynchronous communication but add little value beyond that, or they are too structured for them to be intuitive and free-flowing. We are on our journey to create a product that is simple to use, intuitive enough for your mom, will not force you into boxes, and can allow for the simplest to the most complex of collaborations.
